INTERGOVERNMENTAL AFFAIRS
  COMMITTEE AGENDA
  MONDAY, APRIL 29, 2024
  WASHINGTON, DC
  , 12:01 PM

Roberto Uranga, Chair
Cindy Allen, Vice Chair
Megan Kerr, Member

  SPECIAL MEETING HELD IN WASHINGTON, DC

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-53119  Recommendation that a quorum of the Intergovernmental Affairs Committee arrive
  in Washington, DC, from April 29-30, 2024, to attend meetings to discuss Long
  Beach’s 2024 Legislative Agenda, pertinent federal issues affecting the City, and
  Long Beach priority projects.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 ADJOURNMENT

 I, Tamela Austin, City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours prior to
 the meeting.

 NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
 https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
 Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
 cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
